note: Demo inbox. Every business and person here is invented. Outcomes are not stored in this file: each message is run through the real graph at startup, and the scripted decisions below only apply to quotes the pricing rules sent to a person. Timing: the newest requests are placed minutes before the demo clock's now, the rest at working hours on the previous business days.
